subject.title: fix(agent-tools): guard system prompt tool reports

question: Should maintainers land this narrow metadata-getter guard, or use a broader same-file hardening draft such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89565 as the canonical branch?
rationale: The code change is plausible, but multiple open maintainer drafts overlap the same diagnostic report surface and green CI cannot decide the intended landing order or split.

options.title: Use The Broader Same-File Draft
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89565 if maintainers want one branch to cover descriptor metadata and schema-property traps together.

options.title: Land This Narrow Guard First
options.body: Merge this PR first only if descriptor metadata hardening should intentionally ship separately from schema-property hardening.

options.title: Pause Until Unified
options.body: Keep this PR open but paused until the fuzzing sweep converges on one report-hardening shape.

recommendation.title: Use The Broader Same-File Draft
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89565 if maintainers want one branch to cover descriptor metadata and schema-property traps together.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns this PR and the overlapping hardening drafts, so he is the best first routing candidate for branch sequencing.
